schemas.UpdateStart: {started:true}|{started:false,reason:'already-running'|'invalid-names'|'unsafe-command-path'}; thrown failures are outside this union.
schemas.EnvironmentId: string length1..128, optional for local. No trim, no null, no SSH-specific validation in management handlers.
schemas.SkillName: string matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ (management). Update names use distinct ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$ with no explicit length bound.
schemas.PackageIdentity: strict {packageId:string length1..128,versionId:string length1..128,packageDigest:lowercase hex64,archiveSha256:lowercase hex64,compressedBytes:positive integer <=41943040}. No cross-check between claimed digest and bytes in preview.
schemas.Destination: strict tagged union {scope:'global',environmentId?:nonempty string,executionTarget?:strict {kind:'host'}|strict {kind:'wsl',distro:nonempty string}|strict {kind:'ssh',connectionId:string length1..128}} | strict {scope:'workspace',worktreeId?:nonempty string,folderWorkspaceId?:nonempty string}; workspace requires exactly one truthy identity; no nullable fields. Outer environmentId chooses transport; inner destination.environmentId is authority check, not interchangeable.
schemas.InstallPreview: stripping {name:SkillName,packageDigest:lowercase hex64,destinationIdentity:string,currentState:'missing'|'unchanged'|'clean-update'|'modified'|'unowned'|'external-link'|'name-collision',providers:{provider:string,topology:'canonical-copy'|'provider-alias'|'independent-copy',state:'ready'|'missing'|'conflict'}[]}; nested provider objects strip. No max provider length/count.
schemas.BundlePackageIdentity: strict {packageId:^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$,versionId:same,bundleDigest:lowercase hex64,archiveSha256:lowercase hex64,compressedBytes:positive integer <=41943040}. Different ID grammar than single-package preview.
schemas.BundlePreview: stripping {packageId:bundle ID,versionId:bundle ID,bundleDigest:lowercase hex64,destinationIdentity:string,skills:(strict SelectedSkill extended with currentState:InstallPreview.currentState)[]}. No output max count or uniqueness refinement.
schemas.InstallResult: stripping {operationId:string,status:'installed'|'updated'|'unchanged'|'removed'|'conflict'|'partial'|'cancelled'|'failed',name:string,packageDigest:string,canonicalPath?:string,placements:{provider:string,path:string,topology:'canonical-copy'|'provider-alias'|'independent-copy',status:'installed'|'unchanged'|'removed'|'skipped'|'failed',errorCategory?:string,failure?:InstallFailure}[],conflict?:{kind:'modified'|'unowned'|'external-link'|'name-collision',existingDigest?:string},errorCategory?:string,failure?:InstallFailure}; nested placements/conflict strip, no null accepted, no digest format restriction here. Actual removal emits conflict/removed/partial or rejects, not every union variant.
schemas.ManagedInstalls: array max2048 of stripping {name:SkillName,packageId:string,versionId:string,packageDigest:lowercase hex64,bundleDigest?:lowercase hex64,scope:'global'|'workspace',destinationIdentity:string,destination:Destination,providers?:string[length1..64][max64],installedAt:string,state:'unchanged'|'modified'|'missing'}. installedAt is not parsed ISO. Runtime native list does not run this parser; remote/SSH lists do.
schemas.DeleteRequest: strict {operationId:string length1..128,target?:DiscoveryTarget,skills:array length1..512 of strict {id:string length1..128,directoryPath:string length1..4096,skillFilePath:string length1..4096,name:string length1..256,updatedAt:number|null}}. Top-level target:null invalid; nested target strips. No unique IDs/paths refinement, no absolute-path or SKILL.md-basename schema check; host plan applies containment/depth/freshness. directoryPath/name/id are not trusted as deletion authority.
schemas.DeletePlan: {operationId:string,skills:{id:string,name:string,canonicalPath:string,placements:{path:string,kind:'canonical'|'alias-dir'|'alias-file',rootLabel:string}[],blocked?:'bundled'|'plugin'|'unowned'|'missing'|'stale'}[]}. Exported parser additionally bounds IDs1..128, path1..4096, name/rootLabel<=256 and placements<=64, but local IPC returns annotated object without invoking it.
schemas.DeleteResult: {operationId:string,skills:{id:string,name:string,status:'deleted'|'skipped'|'partial'|'failed'|'busy',blocked?:DeletePlan.blocked,removedPaths:string[],stagedPaths?:string[]}[]}. Exported parser bounds IDs1..128/name<=256/paths1..4096/arrays<=64, but no local IPC result parse. Optional properties are absent, not null; parser does not enforce status-specific presence.
schemas.TccClaim: null | {claimId:number,promptCount:number}. Claim ID is process-local monotonic counter; owner token is separate internal registration generation. No serialized owner token; no runtime output parser.
schemas.ViewportReport: {browserPageId?:unknown,state?:{scrollLeft?:unknown,scrollTop?:unknown,maxScrollLeft?:unknown,maxScrollTop?:unknown}} annotation only. Actual boundary accepts arbitrary unknown, requires string page ID and truthy state, then Number(...) for four fields; manager requires registered owner and four finite numbers>=0. Empty ID not rejected explicitly; no scroll<=maximum invariant.
schemas.Void: undefined callback result. request-response transports resolve void; fire-and-forget callbacks have no application acknowledgment/result/error schema.
schemas.Unsupported: {status:'unsupported',message:'Update Orca on the selected machine to install shared skills.'}
schemas.CloudOperation: Declared {status:'ok',value:T}|{status:'unconfigured',message:string}|{status:'reconnect-required'}. Actual HTTP success is JSON cast to T (invalid JSON=>null;204=>undefined), not schema validation. ResolveShare/share grant uses withoutAuth and actually returns ok or throws, never produces the two auth statuses; mocked/runtime-injected alternatives still passthrough.
schemas.CloudVersion: Declared {packageId:string,versionId:string,name:string,description:string,packageDigest:string,archiveSha256:string,compressedBytes:number,createdAt:string,releaseNotes:string,manifest:PackageManifest|BundleManifest}. No structural validation in cloud HTTP service; absent/null nested fields can escape or cause TypeError downstream. Only grant.version.versionId exact assertion and finalized.version.packageId equality explicitly checked before installer validators.
schemas.PackageManifest: strict {schemaVersion:1,packageId:bundle ID,versionId:bundle ID,name:SkillName,description:string<=4096,createdAt:ISO datetime offset,files:PackageFile[1..512],packageDigest:hex64}. PackageFile=strict {path:string1..1024,size:integer0..4194304,executable:boolean,classification:'text'|'binary',sha256:hex64,identitySha256:hex64}. Full parse additionally requires valid nonreserved skill name, NFC relative POSIX file paths <=1024bytes/16segments/255bytes each, no dot/empty/backslash/control/Windows-reserved segments, sorted unique casefold paths, SKILL.md, <=33554432 bytes and computed identity digest. CloudVersion annotation does not call this parse.
schemas.BundleManifest: strict {schemaVersion:1,packageId:bundle ID,versionId:bundle ID,bundleName:string1..64 lowercase letters/digits/dot/hyphen, no consecutive '--'/'..', start/end alnum,description:string<=4096,createdAt:ISO offset,skills:strict {id:bundle ID,name:string,description:string<=4096,digest:hex64,files:PackageFile[1..512]}[1..512],bundleDigest:hex64}. Full parser applies PackageManifest path/name rules per skill, strict skill-name ordering, unique IDs/casefold names, per-skill digest, aggregate <=512 files/32MiB, bundle digest. Agent plugin emitted alongside: {$schema:fixed v1 URL,name:bundleName,version?:string,description?:string,author?:strict{name?:string,email?:string,url?:string},homepage?:string,repository?:string,license?:string,keywords?:string[],extensions?:Record<string,Record<string,unknown>>}; parser reconstructs known fields (top-level unknowns ignored), strict nested author.
schemas.SharePreview: Declared {preparationId:string,packageId:string,versionId:string,name:string,description:string,packageDigest:string,skillCount?:number,skills?:{id:string,name:string,description:string,digest:string,fileCount:number,totalBytes:number,scriptPaths:string[],executablePaths:string[]}[],archiveSha256:string,fileCount:number,totalBytes:number,compressedBytes:number,scriptPaths:string[],executablePaths:string[],expiresAt:string}. Actual builder always includes skillCount/skills, uses bundleDigest as packageDigest, aggregate file/script counts from manifests, ISO expiry30min from post-creation time. No output parse.
schemas.SharePrepare: strict {skillIds:string(length1..4096)[1..512],bundleName:string1..64 regex bundle plugin name,target?:DiscoveryTarget,packageId?:string1..128}. No duplicate-ID refine: duplicates collapse via Set, accepted when each distinct ID resolves once. bundleName allows dot/hyphen rules distinct from SkillName; packageId grammar tightened later by bundle-manifest parser. target:null rejected unlike falsy bypass on direct discover.

schemas.CloudInstall: strict {shareId OR packageId:string1..128,versionId:string1..128,operationId?:string1..128,environmentId?:EnvironmentId,destination:Destination,providers?:string1..64[max64],conflictResolution?:'replace-unmodified'|'replace-and-discard-local'|'cancel'}. Omitted operation minted UUID; providers [] explicit means no additional provider placements, canonical still installed; unknown IDs filtered by provider registry downstream, not schema-rejected. Null not accepted.
schemas.CloudBundleInstall: strict {shareId OR packageId:string1..128,versionId:string1..128,operationId?:string1..128,environmentId?:EnvironmentId,selectedSkillIds:bundle ID[1..512],destination:Destination,providers?:string1..64[max64],conflictDecisions?:strict{skillId:bundle ID,resolution:'keep-local'|'replace-unmodified'|'replace-and-discard-local'}[max512]}. IPC copies .shape fields so DOES NOT enforce selected-ID uniqueness, decision uniqueness or selected subset; full executeSkillBundleInstallRequest parse later enforces all three. grant installer defaults decisions to []; explicit null rejected. IPC operationId permits characters rejected by full bundle request's bundle-ID regex.
schemas.BundleInstallResult: stripping {operationId:bundle ID,packageId:bundle ID,versionId:bundle ID,bundleDigest:hex64,status:'complete'|'partial'|'cancelled'|'failed',skills:{skillId:bundle ID,name:SkillName,digest:hex64,status:'installed'|'updated'|'unchanged'|'kept-local'|'failed'|'cancelled',canonicalPath?:string,placements:{provider:string,path:string,topology:'canonical-copy'|'provider-alias'|'independent-copy',status:'installed'|'unchanged'|'skipped'|'failed',errorCategory?:string,failure?:InstallFailure}[],conflict?:{kind:'modified'|'unowned'|'external-link'|'name-collision',existingDigest?:string},errorCategory?:string,failure?:InstallFailure}[]}; optional absent not null; no per-status requiredfields/countbounds. Native bundle service parses successful aggregate, cloud catch-built failure not reparsed; malformed cloud manifest can throw or create invalid typed result.
schemas.CloudPackage: Declared {id:string,name:string,description:string,createdAt:string,canManage:boolean,versions:CloudVersion[],management?:{shares:{id:string,url?:string,pinnedVersionId?:string,createdAt:string,expiresAt?:string}[]}}. schemas.InstallProgress: {operationId:string,phase:'authorizing'|'installing',currentSkill?:{id:string,name:string,index:number,total:number}} emitted only non-destroyed requesting sender; no result acknowledgment. Runtime bundle progress validator strict {operationId:string1..128,skillId:string1..128,skillName:string1..128,skillIndex:integer1..512,skillCount:integer1..512}, no index<=count invariant. Publish {preparationId,phase:'uploading'|'finalizing'|'publishing',bytesSent,totalBytes}, all live windows, send throws not isolated at IPC.
schemas.InstallIngress: Full request strict tagged {kind:'download-grant',url:URL,expiresAt:ISO offset}|{kind:'staged-upload',uploadId:bundle ID}|{kind:'local-file',path:nonemptystring}. rules.behavior: Every Skills callback is wrapped before parsing/side effects: exact trusted UI webContents object equality or synchronous Error('Unauthorized skill IPC sender'). No registration reentry guard or disposer in this helper. Core discover/freshness/update six register without runtime; cloud/install management twenty require runtime at registerSkillsHandlers; delete two register through separate local handler assembly.

Resolved projectRuntime overrides legacy runtime/distro; repair throws. No projectRuntime + wsl selects trimmed explicit distro or default, checks Windows/home/cross-distro cwd, converts Windows/UNC to distro-owned paths. Native cwd overrides repo-list scanning; no cwd uses local repos. worktreeId is parsed but resolveSkillDiscoveryTarget does not itself look up its runtime. Target cache keys distinguish exact case-sensitive paths, repo host ownership, provider overrides; WSL TTL10s vs native target TTL0; native roots TTL10s retain last-known skills5min on shed/abort. Coalescer abandons aged30s work, caps16 abandoned scans, refresh bypasses pending/cache; stale completions cannot cache, clear does not abort old work. Root stat failures become missing; summary failures omit individual skills. A shed/abort root yields exists:true/unavailable and last-known skills; whole target unavailability throws retry message. WSL owns scan/realpath/mtime; bash10s timeout/128MiB output bound, mandatory nonzero/timedout rejects, optional plugin enrichment failure gives zero plugin roots. Root records omitted by protocol default missing, stat time parse failure gives updatedAt:null. No disk mutation intended by discovery; account root resolution and runtime lookup are read dependencies.

Local installed official-name inventory from bundled manifests/snapshots and global lock; home/repo/plugin placements observed, repo roots limited128 with explicit inaccessible sentinel. Does not scan WSL/SSH homes; freshness differs from target discovery. Missing candidates omitted only on ENOENT; other observation failures produce inaccessible/unrecognized with null evidence. Known content uses releaseRevision/digest; lock-matching unrecognized canonical/alias becomes newer-known. Only canonical-copy/provider-alias, at least one outdated, all current/outdated and positively identified, and registered convergable name can be offered. Known lock and all identified disk revisions disagree suppresses unwinnable update. Unsupported copies do not grant or block global update. Whole/official-only tree hashes tolerate specific extra-file cases, not arbitrary successful observation. Inventory result reports scan issues and host timestamp; no runtime result validation.

One runner per registration, in-memory state. start refuses running, deduplicates/sorts names before regex; IPC only checks Array.isArray and does not validate elements, eligibility, manifest membership or length. Synchronous canonicalization/resolveCommand/spawn errors can escape; spawn is after publishing running and before storing child. Normal start spawns resolved npx with --yes skills update <sorted names> --global -y, ignored stdin, piped output, WindowsHide and CLI node on PATH. Output ANSI stripped, CR normalized,32k tail and100ms coalescing. error/close first-wins token and settling latch; rehash after exit determines failedNames when available, nonzero can succeed if requested copies landed, failed rescan falls back to exit result (zero becomes success). Failed topology-filtered alias no longer in convergent set can be overlooked if another copy is good. Cancellation retires token, ignores late output/exit/rescan; childless running becomes idle; child sets stopping and sweeps descendants then root; resolve/reject or12s fallback releases idle. Sweep resolution is not OS proof every descendant exited; Windows unknown identity may skip tree termination. Acknowledge only success/error ->idle. Broadcast state to every non-destroyed BrowserWindow, callback send throw not caught here. No persistent run history/cancellation verdict. The async IPC callback calls synchronous cancel() without waiting for the sweep; its response is not a termination acknowledgment.

Strict management inputs; absent outer environmentId chooses runtime local method, nonempty chooses saved runtime selector; listManaged alone has explicit ssh: stripping shortcut. Preview/remove local runtime may route to SSH using destination executionTarget/workspace ownership. Global inner environmentId must equal owning runtime; workspace IDs resolve against owned repo/folder records, ambiguous multi-host IDs throw; SSH request normalizes global target to remote host and carries resolved workspace authority. WSL destination uses owning distro filesystem. Non-SSH local query waits startup transaction recovery. Paired management requires skills.manage.v1; bundle additionally skills.install.bundle.v1, each15s status probe. status network errors returned as failed status become unsupported; selector/lookup throws still reject. Capability probes can mark environment used and manage shared-control connection state, so these are not globally side-effect-free operations. Direct remote call transport throws remain rejects; false RPC envelope becomes channel-specific Error; successful remote values parsed. Local single preview/list/remove results are not reparsed. No top-level environment null acceptance or implicit trim.

Preview resolves actual destination, provider roots/detection and current receipt; canonical location <home/workspace>/.agents/skills/<name>. Case-colliding sibling/non-directory ->name-collision; symlink ->external-link; any lstat failure ->missing; matching receipt bytes ->unchanged or clean-update; matching requested bytes may be unchanged even without receipt; remaining no receipt ->unowned else modified. Provider entries canonical-copy for canonical readers else provider-alias; ready if canonical reader or lstat absent, conflict otherwise. Some inspection uses native lstat/readdir even when observeSkill is WSL-backed. Bundle local/paired fanout batches8 preserving order; aggregate uses selected digest per-skill, shared archive identity, remote aggregate takes first destination identity. IPC reconstructs schema from .shape and loses shared preview unique-ID refinement. SSH single needs management capability and parsed result; bundle uses modern preview capability or legacy per-item management fallback batches8, aborts siblings on first failure then waits all settlements, retries retryable transport via retry helper; result parsing rejects malformed response.

Removal generates operation UUID at IPC, locks literal canonical path (shared with install), authorizes historical successful roots and recovers prior remove/install/placement transactions. No receipt/unowned/external-link/name-collision -> structured conflict. Modified bytes require explicit replace-and-discard-local; cancel has no universal early cancellation branch and clean owned content can still be removed. Alias/copy removability constrained by recorded ownership/digest; unowned/modified placements skipped and overall partial. Journals prepared ->moving before each sibling rename ->receipt-removed, then cleanup/recovery. Exception attempts recovery then rethrows, finally awaits lock release (release failure can reject after effects). No rollback promise when recovery itself fails. Disk backups/receipt journal identify remaining state; source success union is removed/partial. No callback progress push/cancel token on remove.

Reads at most first2048 regular JSON receipts before sorting installedAt desc. Receipt validator shallow: placement members not structurally checked, hashes/timestamps mostly strings. Invalid/unreadable receipt skipped; directory failure returns empty; any observe failure maps missing, so unavailability is not distinguishable. Native WSL receipt uses distro filesystem for digest, global destination restored to WSL if identity prefix matches; stale workspace/folder identity silently dropped. SSH list filters worktree host identity and rejects ambiguous legacy hostless ownership by omission; folder host must match; remote list result parsed and global destination stamped requested SSH connection. Listing waits recovery locally but does not write receipts itself.

Both calls parse strict request, resolve local native/WSL target, rebuild discovery root authority and inspect host-owned paths; no main-process remote RPC forwarding here. Native/WSL allowlist built independently of renderer row and broadened for discovery roots. Plan compares displayed updatedAt to fresh skillFile mtime within1000ms; null fails stale; plugin/.system canonical blocked even if row home; out-of-root canonical content can remain while owned links deleted. No unique request-ID/path constraint; name/id echoed, directoryPath not deletion authority. Execution recomputes plan before per-skill lock, but does not recheck mtime/identity under lock immediately before rename (race limitation). Lock failure ->busy; blocked ->skipped; continue batch normally. Alias-file stages only SKILL.md; alias-dir then canonical staged as sibling paths; intent journal before rename. Rename failure rolls back in reverse; rollback failure ->partial stagedPaths; staged removal failure ->partial. Fully removed content ->deleted even if receipt cleanup failed, journal retained for retry. Outer exception attempts recovery and returns failed/empty paths, but releaseLock can still reject whole batch. Clear discovery caches once after batch; structured operation observability. Journal staged rolls forward cleanup; prepared/staging rolls back, retains if absence unproved, checks containment/shape/movedCount before replay. No runtime result parser on local IPC; exported output max64 placements/path lists can differ from actual local unbounded result.

Only exact live current main webContents owns callback. New registration releases previous owner claim/removes old handlers; reload main frame/process-gone releases its claim; old late closed cannot remove newer handlers. consume reserves in-memory pending {ownerToken,claimId}, returns claim/prompt count; pending/notified/dismissed/below threshold ->null. ack safe integer plus exact claim/owner sets notified+acknowledgedAfterClose and best-effort atomic tally save; release safe integer exact claim clears only reservation, no durable notification consumption. dismiss independent of claim clears pending, persists all terminal flags and stops watch. Tally version2/threshold1, durable path canonicalUserData/macos-tcc-prompt-tally.json; malformed/missing/old/incomplete tally reset except dismissed survives version change. Counts typechecked number, not integer/nonnegative. Save errors swallowed; claim does not persist; no TCC permission is granted by these IPC calls.

Captured local BrowserWindow operations; only close receipt validates sender.id, other seven do not authenticate sender. Basic destroyed guards except popup menu. Native close hides to tray onlyWindows setting true/notquitting/notgone/notcrashed; one-time notification best-effort then updateUI flag. Otherwise confirmed/gone/crashed freezes bounds and allows close; live renderer prevents close and gets incremented request ID/isQuitting. Quit arms deadline, repeated requests change awaited ID without extending timer; matching receipt clears watchdog but does not authorize close. Timeout freezes/destroys window, not proof PTY exit. confirm sets latch and close; will-prevent-unload resumes persistence, clears deadline, aborts quit hook and emits unload-prevented. Drawn-X request sends isQuitting:false without requestId unless tray-hidden. Dispose removes8 callbacks/deadline; no generic registration token. Platform/Electron throws uncaught except notification. Traffic light sync darwin only rounds18*zoom-6 at x16; no numeric validation.

Only exact main webContents sender; scalar focus true only literal true, every other value resets false. Floating payload nullish ->{}, terminal literal true; panel literal true OR terminal, enforcing superset atomically. No persistence. Document navigation/render-process-gone/destroyed/dispose reset mirrors; did-finish-load clears gone and recovery timer. Recorder early-return bypasses all before-input interception; markdown yields bareCmd/Ctrl+B, terminal flags choose terminal/app policy including zoom, floating terminal yields sidebar shortcuts, floating panel yields indexed jumps. Renderer crash retirement/recovery is distinct from PTY liveness; recovery250ms gated by close/quit/hooks/breaker; no inference that processes exited.

Browser trust requires non-destroyed window sender; configured ID exact, otherwise dev-origin or file:// fallback (weaker than Skills). String page/truthy state then Number coercion accepts null/false/empty as0 and numeric strings. Missing yieldsNaN and manager rejects; symbols/conversion exceptions are not caught (transport may restrict values). Manager requires page map owner senderID and finite>=0 metrics. Does not ensure position<=max. Stores host in-memory geometry; wheel eligibility uses remaining range, deltas clamp. No acknowledgement, no persistent write. This corrects prior syntax-only concern that viewport had no validation; actual downstream finite check exists. Registration removes prior viewport listeners before adding one; no dedicated disposer in this registration module.

Discover first then Set filter/count equality. Duplicate requested IDs normally collapse successfully (leaf claim they throw is incorrect); duplicate discovered rows could fail equality. Inputs target WSL paths are discovered on WSL, but packaging uses native Node cp/read/observe, no distro-aware copier in this path: WSL POSIX source paths are not translated here, so WSL preparation requires explicit acceptance.
